name: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme
summary: A credit-linked subsidy programme that supports the setting up of micro-enterprises in manufacturing and service sectors, generating self-employment opportunities in rural and urban areas.

eligibility_clauses.text: The applicant must be 18 years of age or older.

entitlement_rules.text: An eligible beneficiary can set up a project with a maximum project cost of Rs. 10 lakh in the service sector.

appeal_hierarchy.description: First grievance at the district office.

appeal_hierarchy.authority: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
